title: release-engineering-meeting-notes-2026-10-20
content:
Meeting: Release Engineering Weekly
Date: 2026-10-20
Attendees: Maya Thompson (notes), Ethan Ramirez, Lena Park, Noah Singh, Priya Desai (SRE), Carlos Mendez (QA)

Agenda:
- Review current release train cadence and blockers
- Post-release triage for v2026.10.18
- Hotfix pipeline status for customer-facing incidents
- Change log updates and tagging policy
- Action items and next steps

Notes:
1) Release train status
- Next scheduled train: v2026.10.25 (feature freeze Wednesday 2026-10-21 EOD)
- Branch readiness: 8/10 services have green CI; remaining failures in auth-service (flaky integration tests) and billing-proxy (linting rule change)
- Decision: proceed with train if auth-service tests are quarantined and a canary passes for billing-proxy after lint fix (CX-#122). Canaries run Mon-Wed.

2) Post-release triage (v2026.10.18)
- Incident REL-3210: Observed increased 500s on /generate endpoint due to model cache eviction under high burst. Mitigation applied: raised cache size + emergency rollout of quantized-model-variant v2 for 2 nodes.
- Root cause: KV-cache eviction threshold too aggressive under mixed-length workloads. Owner: Ethan Ramirez. RCA draft due 2026-10-22.
- Customer impact: 3 customers experienced degraded latency; CS tickets created and notified.

3) Hotfix pipeline
- Hotfix REL-3225 deployed to production for realtime-queue overflow; rollback was performed after degraded metrics. Current plan: introduce backpressure at ingress + improve queue metrics + retry jitter.
- Lead: Lena Park. Hotfix branch: hotfix/realtime-queue-2026-10-19.
- Risk: metric gaps in observability for replayed requests - SRE (Priya) to add trace tags by 2026-10-23.

4) Change logs and tagging
- Change log update process: maintain CHANGELOG.md in each service repo; release-engineering to collate per-train list weekly.
- New rule: include one-line impact summary for infra changes (latency/cost/storage) - effective immediately.
- Tagging: use 'release/vYYYY.MM.DD' for train and 'hotfix/REL-XXXX' for patches.

5) Rollback & canary policies
- Canary thresholds: 99th latency increase > 15% or error rate > 0.5% triggers automatic halt and notify channel #releases.
- Rollback runbook: documented in Confluence (linked). Review scheduled 2026-10-27.

Action items:
- Ethan: Complete RCA for REL-3210, include proposed kernel selection changes and cache tuning recommendations. Due 2026-10-22.
- Lena: Add retry jitter and backlog metrics to hotfix pipeline; update playbook. Due 2026-10-23.
- Priya: Add trace tags for replayed requests and validate observability gaps. Due 2026-10-23.
- Maya: Collate change logs across services and publish release notes draft for v2026.10.25 by 2026-10-22.
- Carlos: Run extended canary for quantized-model-variant v2 on staging and produce perf summary. Due 2026-10-21.

Risks & open questions:
- Are we comfortable with the expanded cache size across all regions? Cost estimate needed (infra-team). Action: Maya to request cost numbers from infra by 2026-10-21.
- Does the new tagging rule require updates to release automation scripts? Devops to confirm. Linked ticket: REL-3230.

Decisions made:
- Proceed with v2026.10.25 release train if blocked services quarantine green tests and canary pass.
- Enforce one-line infra impact in changelogs from this train forward.

Next meeting: 2026-10-27 10:00 PT

Notes saved by: Maya Thompson
